title.fr: Les états physiques de la matière

sketch:
Observe: SVG beaker of H₂O molecules with a thermometer and a heater/
cooler slider (temperature control). Molecules animate lattice-locked
(ice), sliding (liquid), or free-flight (vapour) depending on current
T; a small T(t) chart to the side records the temperature history and
shows the fusion/vaporisation plateaus (latent heat) as horizontal
segments. Experiment: given a target state ("liquid at 40 °C"),
student picks initial state + T set-point to reach it. Evaluate:
T(t) curve is shown with state-labels stripped; student labels each
segment (solid / fusion / liquid / vaporisation / vapour). Wrinkle:
shares its plateau-curve engine with changements-etat-corps-pur.
